{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Cross-tabulate channel vs. customer_segment
cross_seg = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])
cross_seg

# Cross-tabulate channel vs. customer_age
# Use age bins to make it meaningful
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['customer_age'], bins=[0, 30, 50, 100], labels=['Young', 'Middle-aged', 'Old'])
cross_age = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['age_group'])
cross_age"}
